paths.description: Homepage and discovery surface: featured title, recent releases, rankings, navigation, account entry, and global chrome.
Comics catalog/listing archetype, representing browse, ranking, and search-oriented discovery.
Series detail archetype and the start of the primary read flow, including chapter selection and account/list actions.
Primary core-task flow: open and read a representative chapter, then use chapter navigation.
Account modal flow: open sign-in and submit empty required fields to inspect semantics, focus, validation, and recovery.
Announcement/article archetype, selected to cover long-form content and current operational messaging.
Intentional unknown route used to inspect HTTP/navigation failure recovery.

findings.summary: The site forces a dark palette instead of following the user’s light/dark preference.
findings.evidence: Computed styles were identical under light and dark emulation: color-scheme stayed dark, body background rgb(17,17,19), and body text rgb(255,255,255).
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() tokens so the existing dark theme has a usable light counterpart.

findings.summary: The auto-advancing hero continues motion when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, getAnimations() still returned a running 1600ms animation and the hero retained 0.8s transitions plus a 5s loading-bar transition.
findings.suggestedFix: In a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce query, stop auto-advance and loading-bar motion and reduce non-essential transitions to near-zero while preserving state changes.

findings.summary: The sign-in modal is a custom role=dialog overlay rather than a native dialog, and opening it does not move focus into the modal.
findings.evidence: After activating the member button, #authModal became aria-hidden=false but document.activeElement remained BODY; DOM inspection shows a div role=dialog with a custom backdrop.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> with showModal(), provide a labelled close control, move initial focus to the first field, trap focus through the native top layer, and restore focus to the opener.

findings.summary: Responsive layout works at tested viewport sizes but is entirely viewport-driven, with no component-level container rules found.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero @container rules while the same card/navigation components are reused in several differently sized regions.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card and navigation regions containment and express local layout changes with @container rules, retaining viewport queries only for page-level composition.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly distinguished and several links have very short target boxes.
findings.evidence: Focusing the first visible control produced outline: none and box-shadow: none. The target probe found repeated genre links only 16px high and footer links 19px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible ring with sufficient contrast and enlarge compact links with padding or pseudo-element hit areas to at least 24px, preferably 44px for primary touch controls.

findings.summary: The mobile lab LCP is slow even though the main thread is responsive and layout is stable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 5.3s (score 0.21), while TBT was 0ms and CLS 0.03. A separate warm trace measured LCP 1.06s, so network/image discovery is the likely bottleneck.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the actual hero LCP image, reduce its transfer cost, avoid delaying its URL selection, and re-test under Lighthouse mobile throttling until LCP is within 2.5s.

findings.summary: Hero and cover delivery leaves meaningful image and request-priority savings.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported 266KiB image-delivery savings and that the LCP image lacks fetchpriority=high. The HAR transferred 2.55MB, 2.38MB of it images, and identified render-blocking stylesheets.
findings.suggestedFix: Add fetchpriority=high to the known LCP image, provide responsive image candidates, compress covers to their display size, and keep only genuinely critical CSS render-blocking.

findings.summary: Several small labels fail minimum text contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured contrast ratios of 3.3:1 for the announcement age, 3.63:1 for the RECOMENDADO badge, and 2.9:1 for the active SEMANA tab, below 4.5:1 for their sizes.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens for small muted labels, red badges, and active tabs to meet at least 4.5:1 in every state.

findings.summary: Focus indication and modal focus management do not provide a dependable keyboard path.
findings.evidence: The focus probe found no outline or box shadow on the focused header control, and the opened modal left activeElement on BODY rather than moving focus into the dialog.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement visible :focus-visible styling and native dialog focus management, including initial focus, containment, Escape close, and focus restoration.

findings.summary: Reflow succeeds, but compact link targets reduce usability for touch and motor-impaired users.
findings.evidence: All tested 360px layouts had zero horizontal overflow, but the target probe found many active links only 16–19px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve the successful fluid reflow and increase interactive target boxes using padding and spacing without shrinking readable content.

findings.summary: Many content images omit intrinsic dimensions and responsive candidates.
findings.evidence: The chapter image audit found 8 of 10 images without width/height and 8 without srcset; the homepage audit found all four img elements without dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height (or a reserved aspect ratio) for every image and responsive srcset/sizes for covers and reader pages where multiple resolutions are available.

findings.summary: A deprecated unload listener prevents back/forward cache restoration.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported the unload event deprecation and an actionable BFCache failure: UnloadHandlerExistsInMainFrame.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the unload handler; use pagehide or visibilitychange only when needed, and verify the page restores from BFCache.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but baseline security headers are absent and first-party analytics cookies use unsafe attributes.
findings.evidence: The headers audit found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. All 7 first-party Hst* cookies lacked Secure and used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS, a restrictive CSP, nosniff, frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy; mark HTTPS cookies Secure and use Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: The page loads opaque advertising/tracking origins and sets tracking cookies without an observed consent step.
findings.evidence: Network evidence found seven third-party origins, including Histats and several opaque .cfd/.rest hosts; Lighthouse found five third-party cookies. Two opaque scripts failed with ORB/DNS errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove opaque ad/redirect chains and non-essential analytics; proxy or self-host essentials, obtain informed consent before optional tracking, and document each retained third party.

findings.summary: The account flow is password-only and exposes no phishing-resistant sign-in option.
findings.evidence: The inspected sign-in/register forms provide email and password fields with appropriate autocomplete, but no WebAuthn/passkey affordance or navigator.credentials flow was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and authentication alongside the existing password fallback, with conditional mediation where supported.

findings.summary: The app advertises standalone installation but has no service worker or offline cache.
findings.evidence: site.webmanifest declares display=standalone, start_url=/, and app icons; navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() and Cache Storage both returned empty arrays.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a scoped service worker with a small offline shell/fallback and cache only stable app chrome and explicitly chosen reader assets; provide retry messaging for unavailable chapters.

findings.summary: Recovery forms omit autocomplete hints that would help users enter account identifiers.
findings.evidence: The main sign-in and registration fields have useful tokens, but forgot-password account/captcha and reset email fields returned empty autocomplete values.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete=email or username to recovery account fields and retain current-password/new-password tokens only on the corresponding authentication steps.

findings.summary: Image bytes are high for displayed cover sizes and responsive image selection is limited.
findings.evidence: The homepage transferred 2.38MB of images; Lighthouse estimated 266KiB avoidable image bytes, and the image audit found an 1600px hero displayed at 431px with no srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate width-appropriate WebP/AVIF variants, use srcset/sizes, and lower compression quality for small cover thumbnails while preserving reader-page legibility.

findings.summary: Optional tracking and opaque ad scripts add third-party work with little visible user value.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 39 third-party requests and the tracker audit found seven third-party origins; opaque advertising requests produced network errors and third-party cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an explicit third-party budget, remove failing/opaque ad chains, defer optional analytics until consent and idle time, and prefer first-party, batched measurement.

taskList.title: Remove opaque tracking/ad chains and establish a consent-gated third-party budget
Deploy baseline security headers and safe cookie attributes
Fix mobile LCP by prioritising and resizing the hero image
Restore keyboard-visible focus and native dialog focus management
Add intrinsic/responsive image metadata across cards and reader pages
Remove unload handlers and restore BFCache eligibility
Add an intentional offline fallback for the installable app
Add passkeys and complete recovery-field autocomplete hints
Introduce container-query rules for reused cards and navigation regions
